paper_title: dKV-Cache The Cache for Diffusion Language Models
caption: table : figure

model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the GSM8K Accuracy of a system under two conditions—“No Delay” and “Delay”—as a function of Cache Ratio, which ranges from 0.2 to 0.5 on a linear scale along the x-axis. The y-axis represents GSM8K Accuracy, also on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 80. The “No Delay” condition is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, showing a sharp decline in accuracy as cache ratio increases: starting at approximately 75 at 0.25 cache ratio, it drops to around 60 at 0.35, then falls to about 35 at 0.4, and further decreases to approximately 10 at 0.45, ending near 5 at 0.49. The “Delay” condition is shown with a solid dark green line and square markers, maintaining a relatively stable accuracy around 75 to 78 across all cache ratios from 0.25 to 0.49, with minor fluctuations. The x-axis tick labels are spaced at 0.1 intervals, and the y-axis tick labels are at intervals of 20. The plot demonstrates a stark contrast in performance between the two conditions, with “Delay” maintaining high accuracy while “No Delay” degrades significantly as cache ratio increases.
model_annotations.German: The plot illustrates the GSM8K accuracy of a system under two conditions—“No Delay” and “Delay”—as a function of the cache ratio, which ranges from 0.2 to 0.5 on a linear scale along the x-axis. The y-axis, labeled “GSM8K Accuracy,” spans from 0 to 80 in increments of 20, also on a linear scale. The “No Delay” condition is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, showing a sharp decline in accuracy from approximately 70 at a cache ratio of 0.2 to about 5 at a cache ratio of 0.5. The “Delay” condition is depicted by a solid gray line with square markers, which remains relatively stable, hovering around 75 to 78 across the entire range of cache ratios. The legend is positioned in the lower-left corner of the plot, clearly distinguishing the two conditions.
